dek: Milwaukee won its first World Series on contact, speed and pitching. The homer-first Yankees should take notes.

slides.label: The title
slides.text: The Brewers beat the Rays *4-1* in Game 5 on Oct. 28 to win the World Series four games to one. It is the *first title* in franchise history.

slides.label: The twist
slides.text: Those same Rays swept the *Yankees* out of the ALDS in October. The team that sent the Bronx home lost to a team that *barely hits home runs*.

slides.label: The formula
slides.text: Milwaukee hit *154* homers in the regular season, 28th in MLB, yet scored *832 runs*, second in baseball. Add a 3.51 ERA, also second, and *103 wins*, the most in the majors.

slides.label: The Series
slides.text: The two teams combined for only *four* homers. Rookie Cooper Pratt set a record with *six straight hits*, and Milwaukee's 7, 8 and 9 hitters went *17 for 59* with 13 RBIs.

slides.label: The Bronx
slides.text: The 2026 Yankees hit *223* homers, second in MLB, and made October again. Then ALDS Game 1: *one hit*. The Rays finished the sweep with a *4-3* win in Game 3.

slides.label: The Warrior
slides.text: *Paul O'Neill* won four World Series in New York, the 1994 batting title at .359 and hit .303 as a Yankee. George Steinbrenner named him *The Warrior*.

slides.label: The walk
slides.text: Game 1, 2000 Subway Series. Down 3-2 in the ninth, O'Neill fouled off four fastballs and walked on the *10th pitch*. He scored the tying run, and the Yankees won in the *12th*.

slides.label: The Den's take
slides.text: Nobody in the Bronx wants *Aaron Judge bunting*. But grit is a *roster decision*, and Milwaukee built it with a payroll ranked 19th. The front office has to bring it back.

question: Yankees fix: MORE POWER or MORE GRIT? Pick one.

caption_instagram:
The Milwaukee Brewers just won the World Series without the long ball, and the Bronx should be paying attention.

On Oct. 28, Milwaukee beat the Rays 4-1 in Game 5 for the first title in franchise history. Those Rays swept the Yankees out of the ALDS. The Brewers hit 154 homers in the regular season, 28th in MLB, but scored 832 runs, second in baseball, and won 103 games. In the Series, the teams combined for four homers. Rookie Cooper Pratt set a record with six straight hits, and catcher William Contreras, a Venezuela native, was Series MVP. The Yankees hit 223 homers, second in MLB, then managed one hit in ALDS Game 1.

The other side: the power is real. It produced plenty of runs and another October berth. Nobody wants Aaron Judge bunting.

Yankees fix: MORE POWER or MORE GRIT? Pick one.

caption_linkedin:
The 2026 World Series was a case study in building for the environment you actually compete in.

The Milwaukee Brewers won their first title with 154 regular-season home runs, 28th in MLB, while scoring 832 runs, second in baseball, on contact, speed and pitching. Their payroll ranked 19th as of Aug. 31, per CBS News. The Yankees hit 223 homers, second in MLB, and were swept out of the ALDS by the Rays team Milwaukee beat.

The lesson travels beyond baseball. A strategy optimized for one metric can stall when conditions change. Depth, adaptability and a culture that rewards the small, unglamorous plays are roster decisions, made on purpose.

Is your team built to win one way, or many ways?
